<h2>Summarise Traits Within a Taxonomic Group</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Resolves the taxonomic group containing 'focal_taxon', collects
records for taxa in that group and 'trait_domain', and returns
per-taxon summary statistics sorted by 'median'.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>summarise_taxonomic_group_traits(
  data_trait_records,
  data_taxon_classification,
  focal_taxon,
  trait_domain,
  taxonomic_rank = "family",
  verbose = TRUE
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_trait_records">data_trait_records</code></td>
<td>
<p>A data frame of raw trait observations. Must contain columns
'taxon_name' (character), 'trait_domain_name' (character), and
'trait_value' (numeric).</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_taxon_classification">data_taxon_classification</code></td>
<td>
<p>A data frame mapping taxon names to taxonomic ranks. Must contain
'sel_name' and the column named by 'taxonomic_rank'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="focal_taxon">focal_taxon</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character scalar. Name of the focal taxon to look up.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="trait_domain">trait_domain</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character scalar. Trait domain to summarise (matched against
'trait_domain_name' in 'data_trait_records').</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="taxonomic_rank">taxonomic_rank</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character scalar. Name of the taxonomic rank column in
'data_taxon_classification' to use for grouping (e.g. '&quot;family&quot;',
'&quot;genus&quot;', '&quot;order&quot;'). Defaults to '&quot;family&quot;'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="verbose">verbose</code></td>
<td>
<p>Logical. If 'TRUE' (default), progress messages are printed to
the console via 'cli'.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>1. The function looks up 'focal_taxon' in
'data_taxon_classification' to resolve 'taxonomic_rank'.
2. All taxa sharing that rank value are identified.
3. 'data_trait_records' is filtered to those taxa and
'trait_domain', then grouped by 'taxon_name'.
4. If the rank value cannot be resolved (taxon absent from
classification or the rank column is 'NA'), only the focal
taxon's own records are summarised.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A tibble with one row per taxon that has data for 'trait_domain'
within the same 'taxonomic_rank' group as 'focal_taxon'. Columns:
'taxon_name', 'n_records', 'minimum', 'lower_quartile', 'median',
'mean', 'upper_quartile', and 'maximum'. Rows are sorted ascending
by 'median'. If the focal taxon or rank value cannot be resolved,
only records for 'focal_taxon' are summarised.
</p>


<h3>See Also</h3>

<p>[generate_trait_qc_report()], [plot_focal_trait_distribution()]
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>## Not run:
data_aux_classification &lt;-
  readr::read_csv(
    here::here("Data/Input/aux_classification_table.csv"),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

data_taxonomic_trait_summary &lt;-
  summarise_taxonomic_group_traits(
    data_trait_records = data_traits_raw,
    data_taxon_classification = data_aux_classification,
    focal_taxon = "Anacyclus clavatus",
    trait_domain = "Leaf Area"
  )

## End(Not run)
</code></pre>
